World-anchored whole-body control on the Unitree G1.

+@misc{yan2026bejepa, title = {{BeJEPA}: A Goal-Conditioned Humanoid Behavior World Model via Unsupervised RL}, author = {Liyun Yan and Haoyang Li and Yang Zhang and Jialing Zhu and Zhanxiang Cao and Zihao Zhou and Keqi Zhu and Yizhi Chen and Huang Chuxuan and Shengcheng Fu and Zhong Jiangwei and Qiao Sun and Chen Zhang and Yue Gao}, year = {2026}, eprint = {2610.23127}, archivePrefix = {arXiv}, primaryClass = {cs.RO}, doi = {10.48550/arXiv.2610.23127}, url = {https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23127} }
(Haldar and Pinto, CoRL 2025) on the hand and object keypoints.

+We transferred the policies to a UR5e arm with an Inspire Hand. For each collection condition and policy, one policy pre-trained on all successful demonstrations of that condition was fine-tuned on five demonstrations collected on the physical robot. The object keypoints were obtained by fitting a cylinder to the depth points.
Study 1: demonstrations collected by the operators
Simulated success rate [%] within 200, 400, and 600 steps, mean over five seeds. Bold marks the highest value among the three novice conditions in each column.
+Each policy was evaluated in 10 trials on the physical robot. The video above shows the success counts of all eight policies.
